title: Generic Configuration
description: Configuration for cryptographic operations, artifact discovery, SBOM retention, and cloud passport decryption

crypt.title: Enable Cryptographic Operations
crypt.description: Specifies whether cryptographic operations should be enabled

crypt_backend.title: Cryptographic Backend
crypt_backend.description: The backend system used for cryptographic operations

artifact_definitions_discovery_mode.title: Artifact Definitions Discovery Mode
artifact_definitions_discovery_mode.description: Configures the mode of discovering Artifact Definitions

app_reg_def_mode.title: Application and Registry Definitions Discovery Mode
app_reg_def_mode.description: Configures the mode of discovering Application and Registry Definitions

use_committed_sd.title: Use Committed Full SD
use_committed_sd.description: When false and no incoming SD is provided, EnvGene enters No-SD Mode: only topology and pipeline contexts are generated, registry requests are skipped. When true (default) or omitted, the committed Full SD is used and Full Generation runs as normal.

sbom_retention.title: SBOM Retention Configuration
sbom_retention.description: Configuration for automatic SBOM file cleanup. When enabled, per-application SBOM retention is applied to subdirectories of /sboms/ if keep_versions_per_app is set. A total size limit step then keeps only the most recently modified file in each per-application subdirectory if the total size of /sboms/ still exceeds 50 MB.

enabled.title: Enable SBOM Retention
enabled.description: Enable or disable SBOM retention cleanup

keep_versions_per_app.title: Versions to Keep
keep_versions_per_app.description: Number of latest versions to keep per application subdirectory. Used only when enabled is true. Per-application SBOM retention runs only when this is set to a positive integer. If the field is omitted or set to 0, per-application SBOM retention is skipped and only the total size limit step runs.

save_artifacts.title: Troubleshooting Artifact Configuration
save_artifacts.description: Controls saving of the troubleshooting job artifact. Per-environment logs are always saved. strategy and size_limit_mb decide only whether the run work directory is saved with them.

strategy.title: Save Strategy
strategy.description: Whether the work directory is saved. ALWAYS saves it on every run, NEVER saves only the logs. Overridable per run by the SAVE_ARTIFACTS_STRATEGY CI/CD variable.

size_limit_mb.title: Work Directory Size Limit (MB)
size_limit_mb.description: Maximum uncompressed size, in MB, of the work directory. Above it the work directory is dropped and only the per-environment logs are kept.

chart_subchart_expansion.title: Chart Sub-chart Expansion
chart_subchart_expansion.description: Temporary rollback toggle. When false, Application SBOM components are derived solely from the Deployment Descriptor. When true, umbrella chart sub-charts are additionally expanded into extra components, the previous behavior. Temporary compatibility switch retained for rollback.
